crossRefs.note: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions…
Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded…
Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and…
Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and…
Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”
Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.
Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, Yahweh.
Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;
Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, Yahweh, have helped me…
They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.
Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will…
I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”
Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people, and be disappointed.…
But Yahweh is with me as an awesome mighty one. Therefore my persecutors will stumble, and they won’t prevail. They…
Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:
Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire…
Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous.
Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t…
He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.
For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant…

translations.web: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
translations.bsb: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.
translations.kjv: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.
translations.asv: All mine enemies shall be put to shame and sore troubled: They shall turn back, they shall be put to shame suddenly. Psalm 7 Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto Jehova, concerning the words of Cush a Benjamite.
